permissions.name: INTERNET
permissions.description: Allows applications to open network sockets for data transmission.
permissions.technical_rationale: Essential for core REST API communication with api.qustodio.com (v1/v2 endpoints), WebSocket connections for real-time telemetry, OpenTelemetry collector otlp-do.qustodio.com, RudderStack customer data pipelines, Firebase Cloud Messaging token synchronization, and remote child profile status fetching.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent Controller App uses this to synchronize family rules, receive child telemetry, and transmit remote lock/pause commands to Qustodio backend servers.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low direct security risk; baseline requirement for all network-connected applications.

permissions.name: ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.description: Allows applications to access information about network connectivity.
permissions.technical_rationale: Used by the Cordova network-information plugin, Adjust SDK, Braze SDK, and Firebase to detect whether the device is connected via Wi-Fi, cellular (LTE/5G), or offline before initiating large telemetry syncs or rendering the offline notification banner.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent Controller App pauses background polling and queues offline mutations (e.g. routine changes or rule adjustments) when connectivity is lost.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low risk; provides network connection type without exposing sensitive location or user data.

permissions.name: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
permissions.description: Allows an app to access precise location from GPS, Wi-Fi, and cellular cell towers.
permissions.technical_rationale: Used in the Parent App for: (1) Centering the parent current position on the Google Maps family locator view (com.google.android.geo); (2) Creating and calibrating geofenced Places (home, school, park) with high accuracy; (3) Testing Panic/SOS location reception.
permissions.enforcement_context: In the Parent App, fine location enables precise geofence boundary configuration and relative distance rendering between parent and child on the live map.
permissions.threat_model_impact: High risk (Dangerous runtime permission); requires explicit user prompt at runtime. Involves real-time physical tracking of the parent user.

permissions.name: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.description: Allows an app to access approximate location derived from network location sources such as cell towers and Wi-Fi.
permissions.technical_rationale: Paired with ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION as required by modern Android (API 31+) location permission model. Enables low-power approximate positioning when GPS is unavailable or disabled by user settings.
permissions.enforcement_context: Fallback location mechanism for the Parent App interactive map views and initial regional geofence centering.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Moderate to High risk (Dangerous runtime permission); exposes approximate geographical area of the device.

permissions.name: POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.description: Allows an app to post notifications to the user.
permissions.technical_rationale: Critical runtime permission for displaying real-time push alerts: (1) Child SOS/Panic emergency alarms; (2) Geofence boundary enter/exit notifications; (3) Harmful web search and blocked category alerts; (4) Child Times Up extra time requests.
permissions.enforcement_context: Enables the Parent Controller App to immediately alert parents to high-priority safety events generated by child devices.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Moderate risk; required at runtime on Android 13+ to avoid silent drop of emergency parental alerts.

permissions.name: USE_BIOMETRIC
permissions.description: Allows an application to use device biometric modalities (fingerprint, face, iris).
permissions.technical_rationale: Enforced by de.niklasmerz.cordova.biometric.BiometricActivity via AndroidX BiometricPrompt. Acts as a parent gate to prevent children from accessing parent settings, disabling rules, or modifying bedtime routines if they hold the parent device.
permissions.enforcement_context: Master gatekeeper in Parent Controller App before entering sensitive control screens (Rules, Limits, Account Settings).
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low architectural risk; biometric templates remain safely isolated in Android hardware TEE/SE; app only receives cryptographic confirmation or CryptoObject cipher.

permissions.name: USE_FINGERPRINT
permissions.description: Allows an app to use fingerprint hardware (legacy API).
permissions.technical_rationale: Backward compatibility fallback for devices running Android 7.0 through 8.1 (API 24-27) where FingerprintManagerCompat is used instead of the unified BiometricPrompt.
permissions.enforcement_context: Legacy fallback for the parent security gate on older devices.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low risk; deprecated in favor of USE_BIOMETRIC in API 28.

permissions.name: BILLING
permissions.description: Allows the application to interface with the Google Play In-App Billing service.
permissions.technical_rationale: Powers Google Play Billing Client 9.0.0 via ProxyBillingActivity and ProxyBillingActivityV2 for managing Qustodio Premium Family subscriptions, renewals, plan upgrades, and grace periods.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent Controller App monetization interface; manages device quota expansion and feature unlocking (e.g. YouTube monitoring, location history).
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low risk; all payment transactions are handled securely by Google Play OS services.

permissions.name: WAKE_LOCK
permissions.description: Allows using PowerManager WakeLocks to keep processor from sleeping or screen from dimming.
permissions.technical_rationale: Used by FirebaseMessagingService, QustodioPushNotificationService, and AlarmManagerSchedulerBroadcastReceiver to ensure the CPU remains awake long enough to decrypt, parse, and display critical incoming child alerts (especially SOS/Panic notifications).
permissions.enforcement_context: Guarantees delivery and prompt processing of emergency push alerts even when the parent phone is in deep Doze mode.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low direct risk; excessive use can impact battery longevity.

permissions.name: VIBRATE
permissions.description: Allows access to the vibrator hardware.
permissions.technical_rationale: Provides distinct haptic feedback patterns for high-priority notifications, SOS panic alerts from children, and confirmation when saving restricted schedules or locking devices.
permissions.enforcement_context: Immediate tactile alerting for urgent child safety events.

permissions.name: C2DM_RECEIVE
permissions.description: Grants permission to receive push messages dispatched from Google Cloud Messaging / Firebase Cloud Messaging.
permissions.technical_rationale: Fundamental push transport permission required by com.google.firebase.iid.FirebaseInstanceIdReceiver and com.qustodio.pasa.QustodioPushNotificationService to receive downstream FCM push packets from Google servers.
permissions.enforcement_context: Transport channel for incoming real-time telemetry, child SOS alerts, and remote device status changes.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low risk; protected by Google Play Services system signature.

permissions.name: PushHandlerActivity_PERMISSION
permissions.description: Proprietary custom signature permission declared and used by Qustodio to restrict invocation of com.adobe.phonegap.push.PushHandlerActivity.
permissions.technical_rationale: Enforces that only activities and services signed with the exact same Qustodio private signing key can start PushHandlerActivity, preventing rogue third-party apps from injecting fake push notification payloads or triggering unauthorized internal intent handlers.
permissions.enforcement_context: Internal IPC security barrier in the Parent Controller App.
permissions.threat_model_impact: High security benefit; protects internal messaging pipeline against inter-process tampering.

permissions.name: DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
permissions.description: Custom signature permission generated by Android Gradle Plugin / AndroidX Core to protect dynamically registered broadcast receivers marked as RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED.
permissions.technical_rationale: Enforces that dynamic broadcast receivers registered inside Cordova and third-party SDKs cannot be triggered by external applications lacking the Qustodio signing certificate, complying with Android 14+ broadcast security mandates.
permissions.enforcement_context: System-level hardening against cross-app broadcast spoofing.
permissions.threat_model_impact: High security benefit; mitigates intent sniffing and unauthorized broadcast injection.

permissions.name: AD_ID
permissions.description: Allows the app to access the Google Advertising ID (GAID) on devices running Android 13+.
permissions.technical_rationale: Required by the Adjust attribution SDK and Google Analytics to collect the zero-out protected Advertising ID for campaign attribution, conversion tracking, and marketing analytics.
permissions.enforcement_context: Attribution and marketing analytics for new parent signups and subscription acquisition campaigns.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Moderate risk; allows cross-app advertising attribution, though respects user OS-level opt-out of personalized ads.

permissions.name: BIND_GET_INSTALL_REFERRER_SERVICE
permissions.description: Allows the app to bind to Google Play Store install referrer service.
permissions.technical_rationale: Utilized by AdjustReferrerReceiver and the Adjust SDK to securely retrieve referral parameters (campaign IDs, deep links, referral partner codes) upon first app launch after installation from Google Play.
permissions.enforcement_context: Installation attribution and family invitation link resolution.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low risk; standard marketing attribution interface.

permissions.name: ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION
permissions.description: Allows access to Privacy Sandbox Attribution Reporting APIs.
permissions.technical_rationale: Supports modern Android Privacy Sandbox attribution measurements via Google Mobile Ads / Analytics without relying on third-party cookies or static device identifiers.
permissions.enforcement_context: Privacy-preserving conversion attribution for parent user acquisitions.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low risk; designed specifically to enhance user privacy over legacy tracking.

permissions.name: ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID
permissions.description: Allows access to the Ad Services Ad ID in the Privacy Sandbox.
permissions.technical_rationale: Enables retrieving the Ad ID through the official Privacy Sandbox framework on Android 14+ devices.
permissions.enforcement_context: Companion to AD_ID for future-proofed telemetry and analytics reporting.
permissions.threat_model_impact: Low risk; governed by Privacy Sandbox user controls.

permissions.name: READ_GSERVICES
permissions.description: Allows the app to read Google Services Framework (GSF) system properties.
permissions.technical_rationale: Used by Google Play Services, Google Maps API, and Firebase components to query Google services status, check Play Services version compatibility, and configure map rendering engines.
permissions.enforcement_context: Required for proper initialization of embedded Google Maps SDK within the Cordova shell.

permissions.name: SEC_BADGE_READ
permissions.description: Allows reading badge counter state on Samsung TouchWiz / OneUI launchers.
permissions.technical_rationale: Part of the ShortcutBadger / Cordova Badge library to detect existing unread notification counts on Samsung home screen icons.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: SEC_BADGE_WRITE
permissions.description: Allows updating badge counter numbers on Samsung TouchWiz / OneUI launchers.
permissions.technical_rationale: Pushes updated unread counts (new activity alerts, pending approval requests) to the Samsung launcher icon.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: HTC_BADGE_READ_SETTINGS
permissions.description: Allows reading settings from HTC Sense launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: ShortcutBadger helper to query HTC launcher state for badge positioning.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: HTC_BADGE_UPDATE_SHORTCUT
permissions.description: Allows updating shortcuts on HTC Sense launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: ShortcutBadger helper to modify launcher shortcut icons with unread counter overlays on HTC devices.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: SONY_BROADCAST_BADGE
permissions.description: Allows broadcasting badge counter updates to Sony Xperia Home launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: Dispatches badge count intents to com.sonyericsson.home.action.UPDATE_BADGE for Sony Xperia devices.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: SONY_PROVIDER_INSERT_BADGE
permissions.description: Allows inserting badge entries into Sony Mobile launcher content provider.
permissions.technical_rationale: Alternative badge update method for modern Sony Mobile devices using ContentResolver insert.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: APEX_UPDATE_COUNT
permissions.description: Allows updating count badges on Apex Launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: Dispatches badge count updates to Apex Launcher via com.anddoes.launcher.COUNTER_CHANGED broadcast.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: MAJEUR_UPDATE_BADGE
permissions.description: Allows updating badge count on Majeur Launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: ShortcutBadger integration for Majeur custom launcher.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: HUAWEI_CHANGE_BADGE
permissions.description: Allows changing badge notifications on Huawei EMUI / HarmonyOS launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: Sends badge update notifications to Huawei home screen via content://com.huawei.android.launcher.settings/badge/
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display on Huawei devices.

permissions.name: HUAWEI_READ_SETTINGS
permissions.description: Allows reading badge and launcher settings on Huawei EMUI.
permissions.technical_rationale: Verifies Huawei badge provider availability.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: HUAWEI_WRITE_SETTINGS
permissions.description: Allows writing settings to Huawei EMUI launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: Writes unread badge parameters to Huawei launcher provider.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: READ_APP_BADGE
permissions.description: Allows reading app badge count on generic Android OEM launchers.
permissions.technical_rationale: Generic badge reading permission used by Asus, Vivo, and other third-party launchers.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: OPPO_READ_SETTINGS
permissions.description: Allows reading settings on Oppo ColorOS launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: ShortcutBadger helper to inspect Oppo launcher badge compatibility.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display on Oppo/Realme/OnePlus devices.

permissions.name: OPPO_WRITE_SETTINGS
permissions.description: Allows writing settings and updating badge counts on Oppo ColorOS launcher.
permissions.technical_rationale: ShortcutBadger helper to send badge updates to Oppo ColorOS.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: EVERYTHING_BADGER_READ
permissions.description: Allows reading badge counts from EverythingMe launcher provider.
permissions.technical_rationale: ShortcutBadger provider read for EverythingMe launcher.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

permissions.name: EVERYTHING_BADGER_WRITE
permissions.description: Allows writing badge counts to EverythingMe launcher provider.
permissions.technical_rationale: ShortcutBadger provider write for EverythingMe launcher.
permissions.enforcement_context: Parent alerting badge display.

custom_declared_permissions.purpose: Restricts execution of PushHandlerActivity exclusively to components signed with Qustodios official developer certificate, preventing spoofed push notifications.
Secures dynamically registered receivers marked as RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED from unauthorized IPC calls from third-party applications on the device.
